items.stem: 下列关于学术研究报告摘要(Abstract)结构特征的表述，最不准确的一项是：
items.solution: 摘要通常依次呈现研究目的、方法、主要结果与结论。A项目的—方法—结果—结论是IMRaD摘要的常见模板；B项关键词常置于摘要末尾便于检索；C项语言精确、客观，避免主观评价；D项用第一人称叙述研究者的个人感受是科普随笔特征，非学术摘要规范。故选D。
options: A. 摘要通常按目的—方法—结果—结论的顺序组织。
B. 摘要末尾常附3~5个关键词便于检索。
C. 摘要语言追求精确、客观，避免使用主观评价词。
D. 摘要应以第一人称叙述研究者的个人感受与心路历程。

items.stem: 阅读一段关于海洋微塑料污染的学术摘要：This study investigates the distribution of microplastics (<5 mm) in surface waters of the South China Sea. Samples were collected from 24 sites... Polyethylene and polypropylene accounted for 78% of the particles. Concentrations were highest near coastal cities. The results suggest that land-based sources are the major origin of microplastic pollution. 该摘要未明确给出哪一部分？
items.solution: 摘要已呈现目的investigates、结果78% highest和结论suggest；未出现方法细节如采样时间、网具孔径的具体参数。A项采样时间与网具孔径属Methods部分的具体细节，最可能缺失；故选A。
options: A. 采样时间与网具孔径等方法细节。
B. 研究区域(南海)的空间范围。
C. 主要污染物成分(聚乙烯、聚丙烯)。
D. 污染来源的初步推断。

items.stem: 下列句子中,重音位置不同会改变表达意图:I didn't say he stole the money. 若要强调是别人偷的而非我所说,核心重音应落在______上。
items.solution: 原句若重读he,强调是他而不是别人偷了钱;如要强调我没有说(是别人说的),则重读didn't。本题要求强化是别人偷的,故核心重音落在he上。

items.stem: 演讲结尾Never, never, never give up.中连续重复never主要起到的修辞作用是：
items.solution: 重复同一否定词never三次构成排比与层递,强化否定语气,凸显不屈意志。B项增强语气、形成层递最准确;A项偏弱;C、D项不符合语境(无讽刺,无对比对象)。故选B。
options: A. 表示对未来的迷茫。
B. 增强否定语气,形成层递修辞。
C. 暗示对听众的讽刺与批评。
D. 引出下文的对比论证。

items.stem: 下列单词均出自高中选必阶段词汇表,其中词义与搭配均恰当的一项是：
items.solution: A项lay与lie混搭,搭配错误;B项affect多用作动词影响,作名词仅在心理学中表示情感,用于日常语境不当;D项principle与principal同音异义,原理应为principle,而校长是principal,混用错误。故选C。
options: A. The book lay on the shelf for years, laying forgotten.
B. His sudden affect surprised the whole class.
C. The scientist explained the principle behind the phenomenon clearly.
D. She is the principle of our school and a kind person.

items.stem: 根据句意与汉语提示填空:The professor gave a ____ (全面的) overview of recent developments in AI.
items.solution: comprehensive意为全面的、综合的,作定语修饰overview。注意不要误用为comprehensible(可理解的)。

items.stem: 下列句子中,划线词用法与其它三项不同的是：
items.solution: A、B、C三项划线词均为抽象名词作动词宾语;D项a sharp中sharp是形容词作定语修饰名词。词性不同,故选D。
options: A. She showed great courage when facing the danger.
B. The book aroused my interest in history.
C. They expressed their satisfaction with the result.
D. The knife has a sharp edge.

items.stem: 下列习语/俚语与其英语释义匹配正确的一项是：
items.solution: A项break the ice意为打破沉默、活跃气氛,搭配正确;B项cost an arm and a leg应指非常昂贵,而非价格适中;C项once in a blue moon意为极少、难得,而非经常;D项hit the books意为用功读书,而非扔书。故选A。
options: A. break the ice: to do or say something to reduce tension or get conversation going in a social situation
B. cost an arm and a leg: to cost very little and be affordable
C. once in a blue moon: very often, almost every day
D. hit the books: to throw books at someone in anger

items.stem: 下列不属于environment/sustainability(语义场)的一组词是：
items.solution: A、B、C三项分别与排放、栖息地、节能相关,属于环境/可持续语义场;D项strength / weakness / courage属于性格特征语义场。故选D。
options: A. emission / carbon footprint / pollutant
B. habitat / biodiversity / ecosystem
C. conserve / recycle / renewable
D. strength / weakness / courage

items.stem: 在给校长的正式信函中,下列开头最得体的一项是：
items.solution: B项Dear Mr. Smith礼貌正式,符合对外信函规范;A项过于亲昵;C项中文式称呼;D项不够正式。故选B。
options: A. Hey Mr. Smith, how's it going?
B. Dear Mr. Smith, I am writing to request...
C. Mr. Smith 你好:
D. Hi Smith,

items.stem: 他是个老好人。译成英语时,最恰当的表达是：
items.solution: 老好人含贬义,指对谁都迁就、不得罪的人;A项a pushover意为容易被说服/利用的人,贴合贬义色彩;B项a kind old man是褒义;D项a good guy也偏褒义;C项a fool与语义不符。故选A。
options: A. He is a pushover.
B. He is a kind old man.
C. He is a fool.
D. He is a good guy.

items.stem: 下列关于英语语法体系特征的表述,最准确的一项是：
items.solution: A项混淆语法与修辞;B项英语重形合(借助连接词、形态变化等显性手段),重主语凸显,与汉语重意合形成对比,符合学界共识;C项过度绝对化;D项几乎不用被动错误,被动语态在英语中频繁使用。故选B。
options: A. 英语语法主要靠语序,不依赖形态变化。
B. 英语重形合,多借助连接词、从句与形态变化;汉语重意合,常以短句叠加表达逻辑。
C. 英语的语序完全固定,永远不允许倒装。
D. 英语语篇几乎不使用被动语态。

items.stem: 用所给词的适当形式填空:If I ______ (be) you, I would take the opportunity immediately.
items.solution: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句,be动词在主语为第一人称时用were,而非was。

items.stem: 完成倒装句:______ (Not until he returned) did I realize how much I had missed him.
items.solution: 否定词not until / hardly / scarcely / never / neither等位于句首,主句用部分倒装。本题already给出Not until he returned,待下一复述结构不变。

items.stem: 下列句子使用全部倒装(all-inversion)的是：
items.solution: A项There stood an old temple是全倒装;B、C、D项用部分倒装did / will / had。故选A。
options: A. There stood an old temple at the top of the hill.
B. Hardly had I fallen asleep when the phone rang.
C. Only then did I understand the importance of honesty.
D. Not only does he speak French, but also he speaks German.

items.stem: 用倒装结构改写下列句子,保持原意:The villagers had no sooner heard the news than they rushed out.
items.answer: No sooner had the villagers heard the news than they rushed out.
items.solution: no sooner...than...句型中,no sooner提前需主句部分倒装had + 主语 + 过去分词。than分句保持陈述语序。

items.stem: 下列对强调句It was his hard work that led to his success.的判断,最准确的一项是：
items.solution: B项是典型It is/was...that...强调句结构,强调主语his hard work,可还原为His hard work led to his success;A项混淆强调句与定语从句;C项错误强调动词;D项错误认为只能用who。故选B。
options: A. 这是定语从句,his hard work是先行词。
B. 这是强调句,被强调部分是his hard work。
C. 这句强调的是动词led。
D. 强调人必须用who,不能用that。

items.stem: 用强调句改写:My teacher inspired me to pursue biology. → ______
items.answer: It was my teacher who/that inspired me to pursue biology.
items.solution: 强调主语my teacher用It is/was + 被强调部分 + who/that + 其余。若强调宾语me则It was me that my teacher inspired...。

items.stem: 下列含有同位语从句的一项是：
items.solution: A项fact后that从句解释fact的具体内容,是同位语从句;B项the news后为定语从句(缺主语,that=the news);C、D项that在句中作宾语,是宾语从句。故选A。
options: A. The fact that he had won the prize surprised everyone.
B. The news that he told us was unbelievable.
C. I believe that he is honest.
D. She said that she would come.

items.stem: 下列if虚拟语气从句使用正确的一项是：
items.solution: C项与过去事实相反,主句would have done,从句had done;A项would + 现在完成时不应与if did搭配;B项be在主语为单数第一/第三人称时应用were;D项错把if真实条件句与虚拟混用。故选C。
options: A. If I have more time, I would have helped you.
B. If he was rich, he would travel around the world.
C. If I had known the news earlier, I would have called you.
D. If it will rain tomorrow, we would stay at home.

items.stem: 填空:If I ______ (have) wings, I would fly to see you right now.
items.solution: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件,从句用一般过去时had(be用were)。

items.stem: 下列省略结构使用不恰当的一项是：
items.solution: C项将状语从句中的助动词省略,造成歧义;A、B、D项均为常见省略(动词不定式、宾语、主语)且语义完整。故选C。
options: A. He didn't come, but he should have (come).
B. — Do you know him? — Yes, I do (know him).
C. While (the car) the traffic light was red, the car stopped.
D. She works harder than (she) used to (work).

items.stem: 下列分词作状语使用错误的一项是：
items.solution: D项Having finished逻辑主语应与if主语一致,且时态不匹配;A、B、C项分词状语使用正确。A项表原因;B项表时间;C项表伴随。故选D。
options: A. Being tired, he went to bed early. (表原因)
B. Having finished the homework, I went out to play. (表时间)
C. He sat there, reading a book. (表伴随)
D. Having lost the key, the door couldn't be opened.

items.stem: 用独立主格结构填空:The weather ______ (permit), we will go hiking tomorrow.
items.solution: Weather与permit构成逻辑主谓关系,独立主格结构作条件状语,用现在分词permitting。

items.stem: 下列复合句结构最复杂、最符合学术语体的一项是：
items.solution: D项使用嵌套定语从句+介词短语+非谓语,结构严密,符合学术语体;A、B项为简单复合句;C项结构较松散。故选D。
options: A. He works hard. He gets good grades.
B. If you study hard, you will succeed.
C. The teacher came in. The students stood up.
D. The hypothesis that the researchers proposed, which had been debated for years, was finally verified by the data collected from a cohort of 500 participants.

items.stem: 将两个简单句合并为含非谓语的复合句:He had finished the report. He handed it to the manager.
items.answer: Having finished the report, he handed it to the manager.
items.solution: 用现在分词完成式Having finished...作时间状语,主句he handed it...表达后续动作。

items.stem: 关于社论(editorial)的写作目的与结构,下列表述最准确的一项是：
items.solution: A项社论的核心目的是论证观点,常采用现象-观点-论证-结论的四段式;B、C项混淆社论与新闻报道、说明文;D项以个人经历为主是叙事文特征。故选A。
options: A. 社论旨在论证观点,结构上常采用提出议题—表明立场—论证—总结呼吁。
B. 社论主要传递信息、记录事件,属于新闻报道。
C. 社论以客观说明事物特征为目的,属说明文。
D. 社论以个人经历与感受为主要内容,属记叙文。

items.stem: 下列句子中,没有使用but / however等显性转折词,却实现了隐性转折/对比的一项是：
items.solution: B项通过时态对比曾认为... 现在发现...实现隐性转折;A、C、D项均为平铺直叙或并列,无对比关系。故选B。
options: A. He is a student. He studies hard every day.
B. I once believed success meant wealth; now I know it means inner peace.
C. The sun rose. The birds sang.
D. She sings. She is singing now.

items.stem: 在求职面试的自我介绍中,下列表达最得体的一项是：
items.solution: B项正式、简洁,突出资历与优势,符合面试场景;A项过于随意;C项仅描述兴趣爱好,未扣岗位;D项无所不能过于夸张。故选B。
options: A. Hey, I'm Jack. I just love hanging out with people.
B. Good morning. I'm Jack Smith, a graduate of XYZ University with two years' experience in marketing. I excel at data analysis.
C. I like music and playing games. That's all about me.
D. I'm perfect for any job you can imagine.

items.stem: 在向教授请求延期交作业的邮件中,下列表达最委婉得体的一项是：
items.solution: A项使用I wonder if / possibly / I would appreciate三个缓和语,既表达请求又留有余地;B项too直接;D项命令式语气。故选A。
options: A. I wonder if it would be possible to extend the deadline by two days. I would greatly appreciate your understanding.
B. Give me two more days, OK?
C. I can't finish the homework on time. So I want more time.
D. You must give me an extension.

items.stem: 下列关于英美文化特色的表述,最准确的一项是：
items.solution: B项感恩节为美国传统节日,火鸡是其标志性食物;A项圣诞节英国/加拿大也庆祝;C项英国皇室不等于美国文化;D项美国饮食单一过于绝对化。故选B。
options: A. 圣诞节只在美国庆祝,英国不过圣诞节。
B. 感恩节(Thanksgiving)是美国传统节日,火鸡是标志性食物之一。
C. 英国皇室传统在美国文化中具有核心地位。
D. 美国饮食文化单一,以快餐为主。

items.stem: 下列关于马丁·路德·金《我有一个梦想》(I Have a Dream)演讲的表述,最准确的一项是：
items.solution: B项我有一个梦想在演讲中多次重复,形成排比与情感层递,是演讲最具感染力的核心修辞;A项混淆主题;C项错把政治演讲混为学术;D项完全不重复错误。故选B。
options: A. 演讲以学术论证为主,语言克制客观。
B. 演讲通过I have a dream的反复,形成排比与层递,强化对自由平等理想的呼唤。
C. 演讲聚焦经济政策分析,避免政治议题。
D. 演讲为短篇即兴演讲,无重复修辞。

items.stem: 在向外国友人介绍中国四大发明时,下列英文表述最恰当的一项是：
items.solution: B项The Four Great Inventions of ancient China — papermaking, printing, gunpowder and the compass — shaped the modern world简洁地道;A项拼写/搭配错误;C项四大发明全部归功于一个发明人错误;D项无人知晓错误。故选B。
options: A. The four invent of China is paper, print, gun and compass.
B. The Four Great Inventions of ancient China — papermaking, printing, gunpowder and the compass — have shaped the course of human civilisation.
C. All of China's four inventions were invented by one single person.
D. Foreigners know nothing about China's four inventions.

items.stem: 阅读段落:Though battered by years of criticism, the artist kept creating. Her paintings, once dismissed as childish, now hang in the world's leading museums. 下列对其价值观的阐释最恰当的一项是：
items.solution: A项坚持自我、不被外界质疑击垮,最终获得认可贴合段落主旨;B项强调迎合批评,与文中keep creating矛盾;C项错把被动接受当作主旨;D项放弃创作明显错误。故选A。
options: A. 艺术家坚守自我、不被外界批评击垮,最终获得认可。
B. 艺术家最终选择迎合批评,改变了创作风格。
C. 艺术家被动接受批评,放弃主动创作。
D. 艺术家放弃创作,转而从事评论。

items.stem: 在纪录片中,画面(田野调查镜头)、旁白(专家解释)与受访者采访共同建构意义。下列关于多模态语篇的表述,最准确的一项是：
items.solution: A项三种模态互补建构,符合多模态语篇特征;B项以文字为主忽略了图像/声音的协同作用;C项互不相关错误;D项过于绝对化。故选A。
options: A. 多模态语篇中,图像、声音、文字等多模态相互补充,共同建构意义。
B. 多模态语篇以文字为主,图像仅为装饰。
C. 各种模态在多模态语篇中互不相关,各自独立。
D. 多模态语篇只用于娱乐节目,不适用于新闻或教育。

items.stem: 阅读:The library was unusually quiet yesterday. Only three students were in the reading room, and two of them were sleeping on the books. 可合理推出的结论是：
items.solution: B项可能是考试前一天,无人认真复习是从事实(异常安静+两人睡觉)推出的合理推断;A、C、D项均超出原文信息(原文未提考试、图书馆关门、座位不足)。故选B。
options: A. 图书馆昨天临时关门。
B. 可能是考试前一天,无人认真复习。
C. 图书馆座位严重不足。
D. 图书馆禁止学生睡觉。

items.stem: 下列句子中,使用隐喻(metaphor)的一句是：
items.solution: C项信息是海洋将抽象信息比作海洋,是隐喻;A项明喻(人),B项拟人(D),D项夸张。故选C。
options: A. She is as brave as a lion.
B. The flowers nodded in the wind.
C. The internet is an ocean of information.
D. I've told you a thousand times.

items.stem: 在描述想象场景时,下列动词最能传达画面感的一项是：
items.solution: A项glimmered金辉闪烁营造出强烈的视觉画面感;B、C项过于平淡;D项were无画面感。故选A。
options: A. The dawn light glimmered through the curtains, painting golden patterns on the floor.
B. The morning was nice.
C. It was early.
D. The curtains were there.

items.stem: 下列对高中生是否应该带手机入校园的评论中,立场鲜明、论证充分的一项是：
items.solution: A项明确表达应该禁用立场,并给出两点理由(分散注意力+影响视力);B项立场模糊;C项以提问回避立场;D项无具体理由。故选A。
options: A. I firmly believe that mobile phones should be banned on campus. First, they distract students from learning. Second, prolonged screen time harms their eyesight.
B. Some people say phones are bad; others say they are good. It is hard to say.
C. Should phones be banned? What do you think?
D. Phones are popular.

items.stem: 在向同学指出错误时,下列表达最委婉的一项是：
items.solution: A项I'm not sure, but perhaps...使用模糊语可能/或许 + 征询意见,最委婉;B、D项过于直接;C项命令式语气。故选A。
options: A. I'm not entirely sure, but perhaps it might be a small typo here. What do you think?
B. You made a mistake! Fix it!
C. Do it again from the beginning, immediately!
D. How could you be so careless?

items.stem: 阅读:Social media use among 13–18 year-olds rose 28% from 2015 to 2020, with daily screen time averaging 4.6 hours by 2020. 在重组信息时,最适合作为分类维度的是：
items.solution: B项按年龄段与年份是最直接的分类维度,便于趋势对比;A项情绪分类不适合数据;C项按地区原文未提;D项错按性别。故选B。
options: A. 按用户情绪分类
C. 按国家地区分类
D. 按用户性别分类

items.stem: 在英美文化中,拜访老师办公室时,下列行为最得体的一项是：
items.solution: A项先敲门、说明来意,符合英美office hours文化;B项随意入座违反礼仪;C项立即坐下不礼貌;D项送昂贵礼物超出学生身份且不符合文化习惯。故选A。
options: A. Knock first, wait to be invited in, briefly state the purpose, and ask if the teacher has time.
B. Walk in and sit down casually.
C. Don't wait for invitation; sit down immediately.
D. Bring an expensive gift to show respect.

items.stem: 下列抽象学术概念词的释义最准确的一项是：
items.solution: A项paradigm意为范式、典范,符合学术语境;B、C、D项均错:methodology不是方法论的最广义,empirical不是理论的,heuristic不是演绎的。故选A。
options: A. paradigm — a typical example or pattern of something; a model.
B. methodology — the study of all methods across all sciences.
C. empirical — based on theory rather than observation or experience.
D. heuristic — derived by deduction rather than trial-and-error.

items.stem: 填空:The professor gave a clear ______ (definition) of the term before discussing its implications.
items.solution: def前有形容词clear,填definition。注意区别def与define的词形变化。

items.stem: 下列哪个词不属于科技伦理主题词群?
items.solution: D项nutrition(营养)属于健康/饮食主题,与科技伦理无关;A、B、C项均与科技伦理相关(基因编辑、AI决策、隐私)。故选D。
options: A. gene editing
B. AI decision-making
C. data privacy
D. nutrition

items.stem: 下列句子时态使用错误的一项是：
items.solution: C项By next year与将来完成时will have finished匹配,但主语I与主句将完成...,未矛盾;A项现在完成时正确;B、D项语境与时态匹配。再仔细检查:C项By the time you arrive, I will finish dinner.,主句应用将来完成时will have finished而非will finish;故选C。
options: A. I have lived here for ten years.
B. She was reading when the phone rang.
C. By the time you arrive, I will finish dinner.
D. He said he had already left.

items.stem: 用恰当时态填空:By the end of next month, we ______ (complete) the project.
items.solution: by the end of next month表到下个月末为止,主句应用将来完成时will have completed。

items.stem: 下列主谓一致使用正确的一项是：
items.solution: B项主语The teacher with his students中心词为The teacher(单数),谓语用单数;A、C、D项均有误:A项主语The number of...用单数;C项each of...用单数;D项one of the students who...中定语从句谓语与students一致(复数),但题面写uses不对应;故选B。
options: A. The number of students are increasing.
B. The teacher with his students is preparing for the contest.
C. Each of the students have finished the homework.
D. One of the students who studies in Japan come from Beijing.

items.stem: 填空:Not only the teacher but also the students ______ (be) interested in the topic.
items.solution: Not only...but also...连接两个主语时,谓语遵循就近原则,与最近的主语the students一致,用are。

items.stem: 下列冠词使用正确的一项是：
items.solution: B项play the piano(乐器前用定冠词)正确;A项the United States国名前加the;D项an honest man为元音音素开头的词用an;A项errand拼写错;故选B。
options: A. She plays piano very well.
B. He wants to be a teacher in the future.
C. I had an useful experience last summer.
D. He is an university student.

items.stem: 填空:______ (The / A) United Kingdom is made up of four countries.
items.solution: 国名the United Kingdom/United States/Netherlands等含合众/联合概念的国名前加the;单独的国名(如China, France)不加冠词。

items.stem: 向教授请求推荐信时,下列表达语气最恰当的一项是：
items.solution: B项礼貌、明确,给教授留出余地;A项过于强硬;C项过于卑微;D项拖沓冗长。故选B。
options: A. Write me a recommendation letter right now.
B. Would you be so kind as to write a recommendation letter for me? I would be most grateful.
C. I beg you to write the letter, sir.
D. Hello professor, I am writing to ask you about something that I think might interest you and that...

items.stem: 听力材料(原文转述):Good morning. Today I'll discuss three key factors that influence adolescent sleep — biological rhythms, academic pressure, and screen exposure. I'll first present data from a 2022 longitudinal study of 1,200 students, then discuss each factor in turn. 该讲座的主旨(Main Idea)是：
items.solution: B项探讨影响青少年睡眠的三大因素贴合讲座主旨;A、C、D项均为细节目录,非主旨。故选B。
options: A. 2022年某项睡眠研究的实验方法。
B. 探讨影响青少年睡眠的三大因素(生物节律、学业压力、屏幕使用)。
C. 呼吁学生减少屏幕使用时间。
D. 介绍青少年失眠的治疗方法。

items.stem: 承接上一节听力讲座。下列细节(Detail)信息中,最有可能在讲座中被重点展开的是：
items.solution: C项屏幕暴露的具体影响与数据对应讲座中第三因素,最可能被详述;A、B、D项均为引入背景,非重点展开。故选C。
options: A. 演讲者本人的教学经历。
B. 听众的背景与兴趣。
C. 屏幕暴露对褪黑素分泌及入睡时间影响的具体数据。
D. 学校图书馆的开放时间。

items.stem: 听力材料(原文转述):Affirmative: We should ban smartphones in schools because they distract students. Negative: But banning them is unrealistic; better to teach responsible use. 两方立场的核心分歧是：
items.solution: A项全面禁止 vs 教育自律准确概括两方核心分歧;B项错把焦点归为价格;C项将辩论窄化为课堂使用;D项混淆技术与教师。故选A。
options: A. 正方主张校园全面禁用手机;反方主张通过教育培养自律使用。
B. 正方关注手机价格;反方关注手机品牌。
C. 两方一致认为应在课堂上禁用手机。
D. 正方支持使用手机教学;反方反对所有教学技术。

items.stem: 承接上一节辩论。如果正方随后反驳:Research shows banning phones reduces off-task behaviour by 35%. 这一反驳最直接针对的反方观点是：
items.solution: B项反对全面禁用 + 反方认为不可行;正方用数据证明禁令有效,直接驳斥可行性论点;A、C、D项与可行性论据无关。故选B。
options: A. 反方主张手机有教育价值。
B. 反方认为全面禁用在现实中不可行。
C. 反方认为手机对学生视力有害。
D. 反方主张学生应拥有选择权。

items.stem: 听力材料(原文转述):At Thanksgiving, families gather around the table to give thanks. They share stories, eat turkey, and watch the Macy's parade. 下列对thanksgiving的理解最准确的一项是：
items.solution: B项家人团聚、表达感恩、共享火鸡贴合美国感恩节文化内涵;A项误读为圣诞节;C、D项混淆文化内涵。故选B。
options: A. 类似中国春节,主张燃放烟火。
B. 美国传统节日,家人团聚、表达感恩、共食火鸡。
C. 仅是商业促销节日,无家庭元素。
D. 仅是宗教节日,与家庭无关。

items.stem: 听力速记中,下列符号最适合替代 increase / rise 的是：
items.solution: C项↑表示上升/增加;A项↓下降;B项=等于;D项×错误。故选C。

items.stem: 阅读学术摘要:Aim: To investigate the effect of sleep on memory consolidation. Method: 60 participants were divided into sleep and no-sleep conditions. Result: Sleep group recalled 27% more items. Conclusion: Sleep significantly enhances memory consolidation. 该研究最可能的局限(Limitation)是：
items.solution: A项样本量小且未提及随机分组是最明显的局限;B、C、D项均为正向结果。故选A。
options: A. 样本量较小(仅60人)且未提及随机分组与控制变量。
B. 实验结论清晰肯定。
C. 实验方法简洁。
D. 实验结果支持假设。

items.stem: 段落:Online education has expanded rapidly. Many students now learn through apps. However, prolonged screen time can cause eye strain. Schools should therefore limit daily screen hours. 该段落的逻辑结构属于：
items.solution: B项现象—原因—建议贴合现象(在线教育扩张)→ 原因(屏幕时间导致眼疲劳)→ 建议的递进;A、C项顺序不符;D项对比无对比对象。故选B。
options: A. 总分总
B. 现象—原因—建议
C. 时间顺序
D. 对比论证

items.stem: 在英语对话中,遇到听不懂对方时,最得体的修复策略是：
items.solution: A项请求对方用更简单的词重述,是得体且不冒犯的修复策略;B项假装听懂不礼貌;C项直接放弃不恰当;D项改用母语不解决沟通问题。故选A。
options: A. Sorry, could you rephrase that in simpler words? I want to make sure I understand.
B. Smile and pretend to understand.
C. Stay silent and change the topic.
D. Switch to your mother tongue immediately.

items.stem: 下列短文改错中,错误数量最多的一项是：
items.solution: B项多处错误:Although...but...不能同时使用;It makes me应用makes it;so I will保留。A项无误;C项went错为has gone;B项含错误最多。故选B。
options: A. There are many advantages for students to take part in volunteer activities.
B. Although I am only a student, but I still want to help others. It makes me feel happy, so I will keep doing it in the future.
C. He has went abroad last year.
D. She is a teacher who is kind and is patient.

items.stem: 改正下列句中错误(每词最多改一处):He suggested to go hiking on Sunday.
items.answer: He suggested going hiking on Sunday.
items.solution: suggest后接动名词,不能接不定式。suggest to do是常见错误。

items.stem: 在描述丝绸之路的历史意义时,下列英文表述最准确的一项是：
items.solution: B项an ancient trade route...facilitated cultural and economic exchanges between East and West概括了丝绸之路的历史与文化意义;A项错指现代交通;C项仅说商品;D项否定性表述不当。故选B。
options: A. The Silk Road is a modern transportation network connecting China and Europe.
B. The Silk Road, an ancient trade route, facilitated cultural and economic exchanges between East and West.
C. The Silk Road only carried silk from China to Rome.
D. The Silk Road had no impact on world history.

items.stem: 下列关于可持续发展(sustainable development)的表述最准确的一项是：
items.solution: A项既满足当代人需求又不损害后代满足其需求的能力贴合1987 Brundtland报告定义;B、C项过窄;D项完全无影响错误。故选A。
options: A. Sustainable development meets the needs of the present without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
B. Sustainable development means developing the economy at all costs.
C. Sustainable development only concerns environmental protection.
D. Sustainable development means human activity should leave no impact on nature at all.

items.stem: 听力材料(原文转述):Man: I'm thinking of buying a laptop. Woman: Anything... actually I just saw the new model. 提问者选 ...(主旨题)。主旨是：
items.solution: B项讨论电脑购买贴合两方谈论内容;A、C、D项均非主旨。故选B。
options: A. 男士打算买电脑。
B. 男士与女士讨论购买笔记本电脑。
C. 女士想买电脑。
D. 男士想买手机。

items.stem: 完形填空:When I was a child, I ______ (1) afraid of the dark. My grandmother would sit beside my bed and tell me stories until I fell asleep. 第 (1) 空最佳选项是：
items.solution: B项was表过去时态,与When I was a child一致;A项am现在时;C项used不接afraid;D项becoming语法不当。故选B。
options: A. am
B. was
C. used
D. becoming

items.stem: 承接上文。第 (2) 空 Her voice was so gentle ______ it calmed my nerves. 最佳选项是：
items.solution: A项that引导结果状语从句;B项which非限定性定语;C项what不能引导状语;D项because表原因与句意不符。故选A。
options: A. that
B. which
C. what
D. because

items.stem:
【阅读理解】
Paper, printing, gunpowder and the compass are known as the Four Great Inventions of ancient China. Papermaking spread west along the Silk Road and reached the Arab world in the eighth century, and later Europe. Before that, Europeans wrote on expensive animal skin. When printing technology arrived in Europe, it greatly reduced the cost of books and helped spread knowledge widely, which later supported the Renaissance and the development of modern science.
问题：What can we learn from the passage?
items.solution: 文中指出造纸术经丝绸之路西传、印刷术降低书价并促进文艺复兴与近代科学的发展，说明中国发明推动了世界文明进程，B 正确。A 与原文相反；C 时间表述错误；D 与 reduced the cost 相矛盾。
options: A. Europeans invented paper before the Chinese.
B. Chinese inventions influenced the development of world civilization.
C. The Silk Road was built in the eighth century.
D. Books were cheap in Europe before printing arrived.

items.stem:
【完形填空·历史文化】
Between 1405 and 1433, Zheng He led seven ocean voyages and visited more than thirty countries in Asia and Africa. His ships ___ silk, porcelain and tea to other lands, and brought back spices, gems and new knowledge of geography. These voyages happened nearly a century before Columbus reached America, showing the advanced navigation level of ancient China.
items.solution: 语境为郑和下西洋"运去丝绸、瓷器和茶叶"，carry（运载）符合句意；destroy（破坏）、borrow（借）、hide（藏）均不合逻辑。
options: A. carried
B. destroyed
C. borrowed
D. hid

items.stem: 关于中华文明对世界的影响，下列说法正确的有（多选）：
items.solution: A 对：造纸术与印刷术均属四大发明；B 对：丝绸之路促进了物质与文化交流；C 错：郑和下西洋（1405-1433）比哥伦布到达美洲（1492）早近一个世纪；D 对：中国在经济、政治、文化方面对世界产生积极影响。
options: A. The Four Great Inventions of ancient China include papermaking and printing.
B. The Silk Road helped exchange goods and culture between China and other regions.
C. Zheng He's voyages took place after Columbus reached America.
D. Chinese culture has influenced the world in economy, politics and culture.

items.stem:
【阅读理解】
Afternoon tea is a well-known British tradition. It is said that it became popular in the 1840s when Anna, the Duchess of Bedford, asked for tea and snacks in the late afternoon to fight hunger before dinner. Today, afternoon tea usually includes tea, small sandwiches, scones and cakes. In the United States, however, people are more likely to grab a cup of coffee to go, and "coffee culture" is an important part of American daily life.
问题：What is the main difference between British and American drink culture described in the passage?
items.solution: 细节对比题：文中说英国有下午茶传统，而美国人更习惯"grab a cup of coffee to go"（外带咖啡），故 A 正确。B 无依据；C 过于绝对（文中只说 more likely）；D 与"British tradition"矛盾。
options: A. The British drink tea in the afternoon, while Americans often drink coffee on the go.
B. The British invented coffee, while Americans invented tea.
C. Americans never drink tea at all.
D. Afternoon tea started in the United States.

items.stem:
【完形填空·文化短文】
In Britain, people often talk about the weather when they start a conversation. This is not because the weather is always interesting, but because it is a ___ topic: it is safe, shared by everyone and easy to talk about with strangers.
items.solution: 语境说天气话题"safe, shared by everyone"，即中性、无害的破冰话题，neutral（中立的/无关痛痒的）符合；dangerous（危险的）、secret（秘密的）、private（私人的）均与 safe 相悖。
options: A. dangerous
B. neutral
C. secret
D. private

items.stem: 英美文化常识填空（用英文作答）：In the United States, the holiday on the fourth Thursday of November, when families get together and eat turkey, is called ______.
items.solution: 感恩节（Thanksgiving）在每年十一月的第四个星期四，是美国家庭团聚、吃火鸡的传统节日。

items.stem:
【阅读理解·经典演讲】
In his famous speech "I Have a Dream", Martin Luther King Jr. said, "I have a dream that my four little children will one day live in a nation where they will not be judged by the color of their skin but by the content of their character." Delivered in 1963, the speech called for equality and freedom and became one of the most influential speeches in American history.
问题：What did Martin Luther King Jr. dream of?
items.solution: 原文明确说他的梦想是孩子们生活的国家"not be judged by the color of their skin but by the content of their character"（以品格而非肤色评价人），A 是同义转述。
options: A. A nation where people are judged by their character rather than skin color.
B. A nation where only his children could live.
C. A speech contest that he could win.
D. A country without any laws.

items.stem: 下列关于英语文学名著的说法，正确的是：
items.solution: 《哈姆雷特》是莎士比亚四大悲剧之一，B 正确。A 错：《罗密欧与朱丽叶》作者是莎士比亚；C 错：《简·爱》作者是 Charlotte Brontë；D 错：《老人与海》作者是 Hemingway。
options: A. Romeo and Juliet was written by Charles Dickens.
B. Hamlet is one of William Shakespeare's great tragedies.
C. Jane Eyre was written by Mark Twain.
D. The Old Man and the Sea was written by Jane Austen.

items.stem: 名著主题理解填空（用中文作答，不超过 20 字）：《老人与海》(The Old Man and the Sea) 中老人 Santiago 的名言 "A man can be destroyed but not defeated" 体现的精神是：______
items.answer: 永不屈服（不屈不挠、可以被毁灭但不能被打败的精神）
items.solution: destroyed 指肉体上被摧毁，defeated 指精神上被战胜；这句话强调人在厄运面前永不屈服的硬汉精神。

items.stem:
【阅读理解·科研报告】
A research team wanted to find out whether listening to music helps students study. They divided 120 students into two groups: Group A studied in silence, while Group B studied with light background music. After four weeks, both groups took the same test. The results showed no significant difference in scores, but students in Group B reported feeling less stressed.
问题：Which part of the report describes the method of the research?
items.solution: 研究方法（method）指"如何做研究"：分组、控制变量、四周后同一测试，对应 B。A 是研究问题，C、D 是结果。
options: A. Whether listening to music helps students study.
B. The two groups studied differently and took the same test after four weeks.
C. There was no significant difference in scores.
D. Students in Group B reported feeling less stressed.

items.stem:
【完形填空·学术语篇】
To test the new medicine, researchers first carried out experiments on mice. The results were promising, so they moved on to human trials. However, the researchers point out that the sample size was small, so the ___ should be treated with caution and further studies are needed.
items.solution: 学术语篇常见让步结构：样本小→结论（conclusion）需谨慎对待。后文 further studies are needed 也提示谈论的是研究结论。
options: A. conclusion
B. grammar
C. hobby
D. weather

items.stem: 评价一篇科研报告的严谨性时，最应关注的是：
items.solution: 评价研究严谨性的核心是方法学问题：样本量（sample size）、变量控制（control of variables）、数据与结论的匹配度，故 B 正确。
options: A. 报告的页数是否够多。
B. 样本量是否足够、变量是否被控制、结论是否被数据支持。
C. 报告里是否有漂亮的图片。
D. 研究者的国籍。

items.stem:
【阅读理解·隐性衔接】
My grandfather never went to university. He taught himself three languages by candlelight, translated articles for local newspapers, and later became a respected teacher.
问题：The two sentences are connected WITHOUT words like "but" or "however". What is the semantic relation between the first sentence and what follows?
items.solution: "从未上过大学"与"自学三门语言、成为受尊敬的教师"之间是隐性的转折（让步）关系：后文用事实反衬前句留下的低预期，虽无 but/however，语义对比依然成立。
options: A. The second sentence gives examples showing the opposite expectation of the first.
B. The second sentence simply repeats the first one.
C. The first sentence explains the cause of the second.
D. There is no relation between them.

items.stem: 句子 "Unlike his talkative brother, Jack rarely speaks at meetings." 中，隐性对比主要由哪个词实现？
items.solution: Unlike（与……不同）本身含对比义，在不使用 but/however 的情况下直接建立了 Jack 与其兄弟之间的隐性对比关系。
options: A. speaks
B. Unlike
C. meetings
D. brother

items.stem: 识别隐性衔接（用中文作答）："The city has planted thousands of trees. Air quality has improved noticeably." 两句之间隐含的逻辑关系是：______（填"因果"或"转折"或"并列"）
items.solution: 植树与空气质量改善之间存在隐含的因果关系（绿化改善空气），虽无 because/so 等连接词，语义上后句是前句的结果。

items.stem:
【阅读理解·书评】
"This book promises to teach you English in thirty days. Sadly, it fails to keep that promise. The chapters are poorly organized, the exercises are boring, and the so-called 'secret methods' are nothing new. Readers' money would be better spent on a good dictionary."
问题：What is the main purpose of this text?
items.solution: 书评列举该书组织差、练习乏味、方法无新意，并建议读者把钱花在别处，属于批评性评价（critically evaluate）并提醒读者，B 正确。
options: A. To advertise the book.
B. To evaluate the book critically and warn readers.
C. To teach English in thirty days.
D. To sell dictionaries.

items.stem: 一则公文（NOTICE）与一篇社论（editorial）的主要区别是：
items.solution: 语篇类型决定写作目的：公文重在"传递信息"（告知、布置、要求），社论重在"论证观点"（评论时事、引导舆论），A 正确。
options: A. 公文以传递信息、告知安排为主；社论以论证观点、影响舆论为主。
B. 公文一定比社论长。
C. 社论不需要有观点。
D. 公文必须用第一人称写作。

items.stem: 语篇目的判断（用中文作答）：某文段开头给出事件背景，中间列出现象的多种原因，结尾提出三条解决措施。该文段最可能属于"问题—解决"结构中的说明/议论语篇，其写作目的是：______
items.answer: 分析问题并（提出解决办法）说服或建议（读者采取行动）
items.solution: "背景—原因—解决措施"是典型的 problem-solution 结构，写作目的是分析问题并提出建议，服务说服或决策。

items.stem:
【完形填空】
Last winter, I was waiting for my train when an old man dropped his bag and all his oranges rolled onto the floor. People just walked past, but a young girl stopped, ___ every orange and put them back into the bag. The old man thanked her again and again, and she just smiled and said it was nothing.
items.solution: 语境是"捡起每个橘子放回袋子里"，pick up（捡起）符合；throw away（扔掉）、give up（放弃）、put off（推迟）均不合逻辑。
options: A. picked up
B. threw away
C. gave up
D. put off

items.stem:
【完形填空】
When I first moved to the city, I felt lonely. One rainy evening, my neighbour Mrs. Green knocked on my door with a bowl of hot soup. That small act of ___ changed everything: soon I began to talk with other neighbours, and the building felt like home.
items.solution: 送热汤是善意（kindness）之举；后文"changed everything ... felt like home"也呼应邻里温情主题。courage（勇气）、laziness（懒惰）、anger（愤怒）与语境不符。
options: A. kindness
B. courage
C. laziness
D. anger

items.stem: 完形填空中，确定一个空格答案的最可靠依据是：
items.solution: 完形解题要依托上下文逻辑（context logic）、词汇搭配（collocation）与全文一致性（coherence），B 是标准策略表述。
options: A. 只看选项中哪个单词最长。
B. 上下文的逻辑关系、固定搭配与语篇整体一致性。
C. 只看空格前一个单词。
D. 凭第一印象快速选择。

items.stem:
【听力·主旨题】听下面对话，回答问题。
W: Welcome to our programme, Dr. Lee. Today you've brought some numbers about city cycling?
M: Yes. Twenty years ago, only 3% of people in our city rode bikes to work. Now it's 18%. Bike lanes have grown from 20 kilometres to 260 kilometres, and air pollution has fallen by a quarter.
W: Amazing changes! And what about safety?
M: Injuries have dropped too, because more lanes separate cyclists from cars.
问题：What is the conversation mainly about?
items.solution: 对话围绕骑行比例上升、自行车道增长、空气污染下降与安全改善展开，主旨是"城市骑行的发展及其影响"，B 正确。听力主旨题应抓首句点题与重复信息（cycling 多次出现）。
options: A. The history of the city.
B. The growth of cycling and its effects in the city.
C. How to repair a bicycle.
D. A new railway station.

items.stem:
【听力·主旨题】听下面独白，回答问题。
M: Good morning, everyone. Before the library closes for repair, please note three things. First, the reading room on the second floor will be closed from Monday. Second, all books should be returned by this Friday. Third, you can still use the online library at any time during the repair. Sorry for the inconvenience, and thank you for your understanding.
问题：What is the speaker mainly doing?
items.solution: 独白首句点题（library closes for repair），随后分三点告知闭馆、还书与线上服务安排，属于"通知维修期间的变动"，A 正确。
options: A. Telling library users about changes caused by a repair.
B. Teaching students how to read books.
C. Selling books to listeners.
D. Introducing a new library.

items.stem: 听力主旨题策略填空（用中文作答）：抓主旨时应重点听语篇的______句和______句，并留意反复出现的关键词。（两空各填两字）
items.solution: 主旨题技巧：首句常点题，末句常总结；同时重复出现的关键词往往就是话题词。

items.stem: The news ___ our team had won the match made everyone in the school excited.
items.solution: that 引导同位语从句，说明抽象名词 news 的具体内容，that 在从句中不充当成分。which/what/who 不能引导同位语从句。
options: A. that
B. which
C. what
D. who

items.stem:
语法填空：The fact ___ he did not attend the meeting yesterday surprised all of us.
（填一个适当的连接词）
items.solution: he did not attend the meeting 说明 fact 的具体内容，是同位语从句，从句成分完整，故填 that。

items.stem: 下列句子中含同位语从句的是：
items.solution: 判断方法：that 后的从句若成分完整（he won the prize 不缺主语/宾语），则 that 从句说明名词内容，是同位语从句（B）；A/C/D 中 that 从句分别缺 told 的宾语、visited 的宾语，或作主语指人，均为定语从句。
options: A. The news that he told me yesterday is true.
B. The news that he won the prize is true.
C. The house that we visited last week is very old.
D. The girl that is standing there is my sister.

items.stem: The sun rises in ___ east and sets in ___ west, so the bedroom facing south gets sunshine all day.
items.solution: 表示世界上独一无二的事物（太阳、东方、西方）用定冠词 the；in the east / in the west 为固定表达。
options: A. an; a
B. the; the
D. a; the

items.stem: 语法填空（每空填 a、an、the 或 /）：___ Yellow River is ___ second longest river in China.
items.solution: 河流名称前用定冠词 the（the Yellow River）；序数词前用 the（the second longest）。

items.stem: 下列句中冠词用法正确的有（多选）：
items.solution: A 对：西洋乐器前用 the（play the piano）；B 错：by bike 为固定短语，不加冠词，应为 by bike；C 对：the Internet 独一无二对象用 the；D 对：news 不可数，感叹句 what exciting news 前不加冠词，用法正确。
options: A. He plays the piano every day.
B. She went to the school by a bike she bought last month.
C. The Internet has changed the way we live.
D. What exciting news it is!

items.stem: It was in the small town ___ I spent my childhood, and I still dream of the river there.
items.solution: 去掉 It was 和空格后，句子还原为 I spent my childhood in the small town，成分完整，是强调句（It was + 地点状语 + that...），强调地点时仍用 that 而不用 where。
options: A. when
B. that
C. which
D. where

items.stem:
语法填空：It was not until midnight ___ he finished writing the report.
（填适当的连接词）
items.solution: It was not until ... that ... 是强调 not until 时间状语的强调句型，固定用 that。

items.stem: 判断句子类型："It was the museum that we visited last Sunday." 与 "It was the museum where we met for the first time." 下列分析正确的是：
items.solution: 前句还原：We visited the museum last Sunday，visited 缺宾语，that 兼作宾语，可用强调句解释（去掉 It was...that 句子仍成立）；后句还原：We met for the first time at/in the museum，成分已完整，where 在从句中作状语，是非强调结构（定语从句语境）。
options: A. 两句都是强调句。
B. 前句是强调句（visited 缺宾语由 that 充当）；后句还原后成分完整，是定语从句。
C. 前句是定语从句；后句是强调句。
D. 两句都是定语从句。

items.stem: ___ by the beauty of the West Lake, the writer decided to stay another week, ___ gave her time to finish her sketches.
items.solution: 第一空：the writer 与 attract 是被动关系，用过去分词 Attracted 作原因状语；第二空：非限制性定语从句指代前面整件事，用 which。
options: A. Attracting; that
B. Attracted; which
C. Attracted; it
D. To attract; what

items.stem: 语法填空：___ (see) from the hill, the whole city looks like a garden with lights shining everywhere.
items.solution: 句子主语 the whole city 与 see 之间是逻辑上的被动关系（城市"被看"），作状语的分词用过去分词 Seen。

items.stem: 下列句子结构正确的有（多选）：
items.solution: A 对：only + 状语从句置于句首，主句部分倒装（did we continue）；B 错：hardly 置于句首应倒装为 Hardly had he entered；C 对：not only ... but also 连接并列主语时谓语就近一致，teacher 是单数，was 正确；D 错：分词的逻辑主语应与主句主语一致，Watching TV 的不是 the TV，应为 Li Ming 作主语。
options: A. Only when the rain stopped did we continue our journey.
B. Hardly he had entered the room when the phone rang.
C. Not only the students but also their teacher was invited to the ceremony.
D. Having finished his homework, the TV was watched by Li Ming.

items.stem:
— Did you enjoy the concert last night?
— Yes, I ___ greatly. The band was fantastic.
items.solution: 答句省略了 enjoy the concert，用助动词 did 替代上文提到的动作（Yes, I did [enjoy it] greatly），避免重复。
options: A. enjoyed
B. did
C. do
D. was

items.stem: 补全省略成分（用中文写出完整句子，或在横线处填所省略的动词短语）：He said he would call me, but up to now he ______.（补全省略，使句意为"至今还没打"）
items.solution: but 分句省略了与前文相同的动词短语 call me，完整形式为 he has not called me yet，可用助动词保留而省略实义动词。

items.stem: 下列选项中，省略使用得体且不引起歧义的是：
items.solution: A 对：状语从句省略"主语 + be"（When [he was] asked about his plans, ...），简洁得体；B 错：though 与 but 不能连用；C 结构混乱；D 比较句中 than I am 后应省略 tall 或用 than I（me）。
options: A. (When asked) Asked about his plans, he just smiled.
B. Though tired, but he kept working.
C. If it is necessary I will go, it will be soon.
D. He is taller than I am tall.

items.stem: 关于英语语法体系的特征，下列说法正确的有（多选）：
items.solution: A 对：英语靠动词变位、名词单复数等形态变化表意；B 对：英语是 SVO 型语言；C 错：英语形容词不随性、数变化（这与法语、德语不同）；D 对：课标强调在语境中学习和运用语法。
options: A. 英语主要通过词形变化（如时态、单复数）表达语法意义。
B. 英语句子的基本语序通常是"主语+谓语+宾语"。
C. 英语的形容词有严格的性和数的变化。
D. 学习语法应在真实语境中理解和运用，而不是只背规则。

items.stem: 语法体系综合填空：Every morning my father ___ (read) newspapers before he goes to work. He ___ (do) this for over twenty years.
items.solution: 第一空表示每天的习惯动作用一般现在时，主语第三人称单数用 reads；第二空 for over twenty years 与现在相关，用现在完成时 has done。

items.stem: 从语法体系的角度看，句子 "The books borrowed from the library must be returned within two weeks." 中包含的语法手段不包括：
items.solution: 句中 must be returned 是情态动词+被动语态，borrowed from the library 是过去分词作后置定语；全句不含 if 虚拟条件句。
options: A. 被动语态
B. 过去分词作后置定语
C. 情态动词表义务
D. 虚拟语气（if 条件句）

items.stem: Either the headmaster or the teachers ___ responsible for organizing the sports meeting next week.
items.solution: either ... or 连接并列主语时谓语遵循就近原则，与最近的主语 the teachers（复数）一致，用 are。
options: A. is
B. are
C. am
D. be

items.stem: 语法填空：The number of students who want to join the science club ___ (be) larger than expected.
items.solution: "the number of + 复数名词"作主语时，中心词是 number，谓语用单数；注意区分 a number of（许多，谓语复数）。

items.stem: 下列句子主谓一致（或代词一致）全部正确的是：
items.solution: A 错：each of ... 谓语用单数 has，且 each 对应 his/their 需一致；B 错：nobody but ... 谓语与 nobody 一致用 knows；C 对：主语 Professor Smith，together with 短语不影响主谓一致，用 is；D 错：police 表集体通常作复数，用 are。
options: A. Each of the boys have their own bicycle.
B. Nobody but the two engineers know the answer.
C. Professor Smith, together with his students, is attending the conference.
D. The police is looking into the case.

items.stem: ___ more time, we could have done the job much better.
items.solution: 句子主语 we 与 give 是被动关系（"被给予"更多时间），作条件状语用过去分词 Given；此句相当于 If we had been given more time。
options: A. Giving
B. Given
C. To give
D. Give

items.stem: The old man sat quietly in the sun, his eyes ___ on the children playing on the grass.
items.solution: 独立主格结构：名词 his eyes 与分词构成逻辑上的主谓关系，eyes 与 fix 是被动关系（目光"被固定"在……上），故用过去分词 fixed。
options: A. fixing
B. fixed
C. to fix
D. fix

items.stem: 语法填空：The lecture ___ (give) by Professor Wang yesterday was so inspiring that many students asked questions after it.
items.solution: lecture 与 give 是被动关系（"由王教授所作"的讲座），作后置定语用过去分词 given。

items.stem: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer and go to that famous university.
items.solution: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，if 从句用过去式（be 动词一律用 were），主句用 would + 动词原形。
options: A. am
B. was
C. were
D. will be

items.stem: If we had set off earlier yesterday, we ___ the last train.
items.solution: 与过去事实相反：if 从句用 had + 过去分词（had set off），主句用 would have + 过去分词（would have caught）。
options: A. would catch
B. would have caught
C. had caught
D. caught

items.stem: 语法填空：If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, the sports meeting would be put off till next Monday.
items.solution: 与将来事实相反（可能性小）的虚拟语气，if 从句可用过去式（rained）或 should rain / were to rain，主句用 would + 动词原形。

items.stem:
【完形·时态整合】
Look at the classroom! The students ___ a model plane for next week's science festival, and the walls ___ with their colourful drawings already.
items.solution: Look! 提示正在发生，第一空用现在进行时 are making；第二空 already 与完成相关，墙壁"已被装饰"，用现在完成时被动语态 have been decorated。
options: A. are making; have been decorated
B. make; decorated
C. made; are decorated
D. will make; decorate

items.stem: 语法填空：By the end of last term, we ___ (learn) more than two thousand English words, and now we ___ (review) them for the coming exam.
items.solution: by the end of last term 是过去完成时标志；now 提示现在正在进行的复习，用现在进行时 are reviewing。

items.stem: 下列句中时态（或语态）使用正确的有（多选）：
items.solution: A 对：since 从句过去时，主句现在完成时；B 对：过去某一时刻正在进行的动作用过去进行时；C 错：瞬间动词 build 的完成时不能与段时间连用，应为 The bridge has been in use for ten years / was built ten years ago；D 对：间接引语中过去将来时 would visit 正确。
options: A. I have known him since we were in primary school.
B. When the teacher came in, the students were discussing the problem.
C. The bridge has been built for ten years.
D. She said she would visit the museum the next day.

items.stem:
【听力·文化负载】听下面对话，回答问题。
W: You look worried, Peter. What's up?
M: My British friend Jack said the party last night was "not bad". Does that mean he didn't like it?
W: Quite the opposite! In Britain, "not bad" is often a modest way of saying something is quite good.
M: Oh, I see! No wonder he stayed so long and asked for the recipe!
问题：What does "not bad" often mean in British culture, according to the woman?
items.solution: 女士解释：在英国 "not bad" 常是一种谦虚地表示"相当不错"的说法。文化负载表达不能按字面直译理解，需借助文化语境。
options: A. Something is terrible.
B. Something is quite good, said in a modest way.
C. Something is dangerous.
D. The speaker is angry.

items.stem:
【听力·文化负载】听下面对话，回答问题。
M: Hi, Linda. How was your trip to China?
W: Wonderful! But one thing confused me. When I praised my host's cooking, she kept saying "nali nali" and looked unhappy. Was she really unhappy?
M: Not at all. That's a Chinese way of accepting a compliment modestly. It's like saying "Oh, you're too kind."
问题：Why did the host say "nali nali" according to the man?
items.solution: 男士解释"哪里哪里"是中国人谦虚接受称赞的表达方式。听文化负载语篇时，应避免直译式误解，结合文化背景判断真实含义。
options: A. Because she was angry with Linda.
B. Because she wanted Linda to leave.
C. Because she was modestly accepting the praise in the Chinese way.
D. Because she did not understand English.

items.stem: 听力文化策略填空（用中文作答）：听到英美人说 "It's an interesting idea."（重音正常、语气委婉）委婉表达不同意见时，正确的理解策略是：结合______、语调和语境判断言外之意，而不是只按字面词义理解。
items.solution: 文化负载语篇的理解策略：结合文化背景（cultural context）、语音语调与具体语境推断言外之意，避免字面直译。

items.stem:
【听力·辩论】听下面辩论节选，回答问题。
M: I believe students should be allowed to use AI tools for homework. These tools can explain difficult points at any time, like a patient private teacher.
W: I see your point, but if students depend on AI for every answer, they lose the chance to think for themselves. Solving problems alone is how real learning happens.
M: That's true, but used properly — as a tutor, not a substitute — AI can actually give students more time to think deeply.
问题：What is the woman's main concern?
items.solution: 女士的核心论点是 "they lose the chance to think for themselves"（依赖 AI 会丧失独立思考的机会），B 是同义转述。辩论听力要抓各方的论点与反驳。
options: A. AI tools are too expensive for students.
B. Students may lose the ability to think independently if they depend on AI.
C. AI tools are difficult to use.
D. Homework should be cancelled.

items.stem: 【听力·辩论】接上题材料。问题：How does the man respond to the woman's objection?
items.solution: 男士回应 "That's true, but used properly — as a tutor, not a substitute — ..."，先让步再限定立场，属于"让步+澄清"的反驳策略，选 C。
options: A. He completely gives up his opinion.
B. He agrees AI should be banned.
C. He makes a concession and clarifies that AI should be used as a tutor, not a substitute.
D. He changes the topic to the price of AI.

items.stem: 辩论听力策略填空（用中文作答）：听辩论时应重点记录双方各自的______和支撑理由，并注意 but、however 等信号词后的______内容。
items.answer: 立场（观点）；反驳（关键论证）
items.solution: 辩论听力要点：分清双方立场（position）与理由（supporting reasons），but/however 等信号词后常出现反驳或转折性关键信息。

items.stem:
【听力·学术讲座】听下面讲座节选，回答问题。
W: Good morning. Today's lecture focuses on urban green spaces — parks, gardens and green roofs in cities. Why do they matter? First, they cool the city in summer. For example, a park can be two to three degrees cooler than nearby streets. Second, they reduce stress. Studies show that people who walk in parks daily report better sleep. Third — and this is often ignored — they provide homes for city birds and insects.
问题：Which of the following is presented as an example, not a main point?
items.solution: 讲座结构：三个主旨（降温、减压、提供栖息地），其中"公园比街道低两三度"是 For example 引出的举例细节，用于支撑第一点，B 正确。听讲座应区分主旨、细节与举例。
options: A. Urban green spaces cool the city.
B. A park can be two to three degrees cooler than nearby streets.
C. Green spaces reduce stress.
D. Green spaces provide homes for wildlife.

items.stem: 【听力·学术讲座】接上题材料。问题：What does the speaker mean by "and this is often ignored"?
items.solution: "this is often ignored" 提示第三点（城市绿地为鸟虫提供栖息地）常被忽视但重要，属于说话人强调重要信息的方式。
options: A. The third point receives little attention but matters.
B. The speaker forgot the third point.
C. The third point is wrong.
D. The lecture is over.

items.stem: 学术讲座听力策略填空（用中文作答）：听学术讲座时，应按"研究问题—方法—结果—结论"的框架筛选信息，把举例性细节记为______层级，把每部分的主题句记为______层级。
items.answer: 次级（细节/支撑）；主旨（核心）
items.solution: 结构化信息筛选：主题句（主旨）记在高层级，举例、数据等支撑性细节记在次级，便于复述与答题。

items.stem: 结构化速记中，符号 "↑" 最适合记录的信息是：
items.solution: 常用速记符号：↑ 表上升/增长，↓ 表下降，∵ 表原因，∴ 表结果，vs 表对比，→ 表导致/顺序。
options: A. 上升、增长
B. 原因
C. 对比
D. 时间顺序

items.stem: 听一段关于"城市交通改善措施"的讲座，最符合"结构化笔记"要求的做法是：
items.solution: 结构化笔记三要素：分类分行、缩略符号记关键词、层级缩进显结构；逐字记录跟不上语速且不利复述。
options: A. 逐字把每个英文单词都写下来。
B. 按措施分类分行，用缩写和符号记关键词，并用层级缩进体现结构。
C. 只画图不写任何文字。
D. 事后凭记忆口述，不做任何记录。

items.stem: 速记实践填空：为提高笔记速度，常用缩写 "eg" 表示 ______，"info" 表示 ______。（用英文写出单词全拼）
items.solution: 常见缩略：eg = for example，info = information；速记用缩略、符号与层级缩进配合，便于事后整理复述。

items.stem:
【信息处理】阅读下面从三则材料中摘出的信息：
① The school library is open from 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekdays.
② The city museum offers free entry on the first Sunday of each month.
③ The school library closes at 5 p.m. on Saturdays and is closed on Sundays.
问题：If you plan to visit both places in one free day without paying, which day should you choose and what must you check first?
items.solution: 免费参观博物馆须在每月第一个星期日；该日图书馆闭馆（③），若想"一天两处"需核对是否有冲突——信息重组后发现两条件在同一天相互冲突，故选 A（并意识到需先核对开放信息）。
options: A. A first Sunday that is not a weekday; check the library's Sunday opening first.
B. Any Saturday; check the museum's ticket price.
C. Monday; check the library's closing time.
D. Any weekday; nothing needs checking.

items.stem: 要把一段介绍"可再生能源"的短文信息重组为表格，最合理的分类维度是：
items.solution: 信息重组的关键是选择与任务目标一致的分类维度：主题（能源类型）×属性（优点/局限）能保留并重组原文核心信息。
options: A. 按字母顺序排列所有单词。
B. 按能源类型（太阳能/风能/水能等）分类，并列出各自优点与局限。
C. 按句子长短分类。
D. 只保留数字，删除其他内容。

items.stem: 信息筛选策略填空（用中文作答）：面对大量材料时，应先明确任务目标，再按______筛除无关信息，按主题给保留信息______，最后整合成新结构（表格、思维导图等）。
items.solution: 筛选—分类—重组三步：以任务目标定相关性筛选，按主题分类，再整合为表格/导图等新结构，为创建新信息奠基。

items.stem: 在英国朋友家做客，饭后想表达感谢，最得体的说法是：
items.solution: 按英语文化礼貌规范，接受款待后应真诚致谢并给予正面评价；B 得体自然。A、C、D 都违背礼貌原则。
options: A. The food was terrible, but I ate it anyway.
B. Thank you so much for the lovely dinner. Everything was delicious.
C. I did not like the food at all.
D. Your cooking is worse than my mother's.

items.stem: 想请外教帮你修改申请书，下列表达最委婉得体的是：
items.solution: B 使用 Could you possibly、if you are not too busy 等委婉手段，既提出请求又给对方留出拒绝空间，符合礼貌规范。
options: A. Correct my application letter now.
B. Could you possibly spare some time to look through my application letter, if you are not too busy?
C. You must help me with my letter.
D. I leave my letter here. Do it quickly.

items.stem: 在不同文化语境中礼貌交流，下列做法恰当的有（多选）：
items.solution: A 是委婉拒绝的礼貌策略；B 符合英语文化接受赞美的习惯；C 符合正式场合的称谓规范；D 打断他人且大声不符合任何主流文化的礼貌规范。
options: A. 用间接、委婉的方式表达拒绝，如 I'm afraid I have another commitment.
B. 收到赞美时按英语文化习惯说 Thank you 表示接受。
C. 初次见面的商务场合直呼对方姓氏加称谓（如 Mr. Smith），除非对方邀请你直呼其名。
D. 不分场合大声打断别人说话以显示热情。

items.stem: 语音表意填空：句子 "I didn't say she stole the money." 若要强调"钱是被偷了，但不是我说的"，核心重音应落在 ______ 上（写出句中单词）。
items.solution: 重音位置改变焦点：重读 didn't 强调"我没说（是别人说的）"；重音转移（如 he/she/money）则分别强调不同言外之意。

items.stem: 朗读句子 "You finished the whole project by yourself?" 想表达惊讶，应该：
items.solution: 表达惊讶可用升调+关键词重音（by yourself 重读）+语调起伏，这是运用语音手段（重音、语调、节奏）传达态度的典型方式。
options: A. 用平淡的降调匀速读完。
B. 用升调并在 by yourself 上加重读音，语调有起伏。
C. 用耳语一口气读完。
D. 停顿越多越好，每词都停。

items.stem: 关于语音手段的表达功能，下列说法正确的是：
items.solution: 语音的表意功能：重音突出焦点、语调区分语气（疑问/惊讶/肯定）、节奏传达态度，是意义表达的有机部分。
options: A. 重音、语调和节奏只影响听起来是否好听，不影响意义表达。
B. 同一句话用不同语调朗读，可以传达疑问、惊讶、肯定等不同态度。
C. 说话时所有单词都应平均用力。
D. 节奏与表达意图和态度无关。

items.stem: 在正式的毕业典礼上向校长致辞致谢，最合适的语言风格是：
items.solution: 正式场合（典礼）+正式关系（对校长/师长）应选用正式语体：完整句式、礼貌套语（I would like to express our sincere gratitude），B 得体。
options: A. Hey, thanks a lot for everything, guys!
B. On behalf of all graduates, I would like to express our sincere gratitude to our teachers and our school.
C. 用网络缩略语随意表达。
D. 只说一个词 Thanks。

items.stem: 朋友向你倾诉考试失利的烦恼，情感距离近、场合非正式，最恰当的回应是：
items.solution: 亲密关系+情感支持场合：先共情（I'm really sorry to hear that），再提供倾听与帮助，符合"情感距离近、非正式"的交际得体性。
options: A. That serves you right. You never study.
B. I'm really sorry to hear that. Do you want to talk about it? Maybe I can help.
C. It's none of my business.
D. 公式化引用法律条文进行说教。

items.stem: 交际得体性填空（用中文作答）：根据社会交往场合的正式程度、行事程序和情感距离选择语言形式，称作交际的______；正式程度越高，语言通常越______（填"正式/随意"）。
items.solution: 语用得体性原则：场正式程度、程序与情感距离决定语体选择；场合越正式，语言越正式、句式越完整。

items.stem: 小组讨论中你想表达不同意见又不失礼貌，最合适的说法是：
items.solution: B 先认可对方（I see your point），再用 not sure、perhaps 等模糊语软化异议，既表达了观点又避免了生硬对抗。
options: A. You are completely wrong.
B. I see your point, but I'm not sure I fully agree. Perhaps we could also consider ...
C. Stop talking. Listen to me.
D. Your idea is the worst one.

items.stem: 下列句子中使用了委婉/模糊手段的是：
items.solution: B 中 I'm afraid、might、slight 都是典型的模糊语/委婉语，用于缓和负面信息的语气；A、C、D 是客观直陈。
options: A. The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
B. I'm afraid there might be a slight problem with the plan.
C. Water boils at 100 degrees.
D. There are seven days in a week.

items.stem: 关于委婉语与模糊语的功能，下列说法正确的有（多选）：
items.solution: 委婉语/模糊语的语用功能：缓和语气、留余地、避免冒犯、调节正式程度；它不等于说谎，只是表达方式更礼貌含蓄。
options: A. 使观点表达更温和、留有余地。
B. 避免过于直接而冒犯他人。
C. 完全等同于说谎。
D. 在正式书面语和口头交流中都常用来调节语气。

items.stem: 给老师发邮件请延期交作业，语气强度控制最恰当的是：
items.solution: 对师长提出请求应降低语气强度：用 I was wondering if ... 委婉句式 + 理由 + 感谢，控制直接程度与篇幅，B 最恰当。
options: A. Give me two more days. Now.
B. I was wondering if it would be possible for me to submit the assignment two days later, as I have been ill this week. Thank you for understanding.
C. I will not do the homework ever.
D. 命令语气并使用全大写字母催促。

items.stem: 同一件事"提醒同学归还借书"，语气由强到弱排列正确的是：
items.solution: 情态动词 must/命令句最直接（最强）；Could you...? 疑问请求居中；陈述+whenever you're ready 最含蓄（最弱），A 的排序正确。
options: A. You must return my book today. > Could you return my book when you finish it? > I still have that book of mine, whenever you're ready.
B. Could you return ...? > You must return ... > whenever you're ready ...
C. 三种说法语气强度完全相同。
D. 语气强弱无法比较。

items.stem: 语气调节填空（用中文作答）：向长辈或上级提出异议时，应______（填"提高/降低"）表达的直接程度，并适当控制______，使语气委婉而有分寸。
items.answer: 降低；篇幅（直接程度/措辞强度）
items.solution: 语气控制三手段：调节直接程度、控制篇幅长短、软化措辞；对上交际宜降低直接程度、简洁而有礼。

items.stem:
【学术阅读】阅读下面摘要，回答问题。
Sleep problems among teenagers are a growing concern. This study asks whether evening screen use affects sleep quality. Fifty boarding-school students recorded their screen time and sleep for two weeks. Students who used screens after 10 p.m. fell asleep about forty minutes later and reported poorer sleep quality than those who did not.
问题：According to the abstract, what belongs to the "method" part of the study?
items.solution: 按"研究问题—方法—结果—结论"框架：研究问题=屏幕使用是否影响睡眠（A/C 混淆问题与结论），方法=50 名寄宿生记录两周数据（B），结果是入睡推迟约 40 分钟等。
options: A. Sleep problems are a growing concern.
B. Fifty students recorded their screen time and sleep for two weeks.
C. Evening screen use affects sleep.
D. Screens should be banned.

items.stem: 按学术语篇的常规结构（IMRaD 思路），下列排列正确的是：
items.solution: 学术报告常规顺序：引言提出研究问题，方法说明怎么做，结果报告发现，讨论解释意义并得出结论。
options: A. 结果 → 方法 → 引言 → 讨论
B. 引言（研究问题）→ 方法 → 结果 → 讨论（结论）
C. 讨论 → 结果 → 引言 → 方法
D. 方法 → 引言 → 讨论 → 结果

items.stem: 学术阅读策略填空（用中文作答）：读学术语篇时，应先定位______（研究者要回答的问题），再核查______是否支持其结论。
items.answer: 研究问题；数据（证据/结果）
items.solution: 批判性学术阅读：先找研究问题，再检查方法与数据是否真正支撑结论，避免被结论性断言带偏。

items.stem:
【阅读·态度评价】
In his diary, the young doctor wrote: "The village has no hospital, and people walk thirty kilometres to see a doctor. Every night I ask myself — should I stay in the comfortable city, or stay here where I am needed? Today, when a mother thanked me with a basket of eggs, I knew my answer."
问题：What can we infer about the doctor's values?
items.solution: 日记呈现内心抉择，"where I am needed"与村民的感谢让他找到答案，表明他把服务需要帮助的人作为人生价值，B 正确。
options: A. He values personal wealth above all.
B. He finds meaning in serving people who need him most.
C. He dislikes the villagers.
D. He believes doctors should avoid poor areas.

items.stem: 评价语篇作者态度时，最可靠的依据是：
items.solution: 态度评价须基于文本证据：词汇的情感色彩（褒/贬）、所举事例与论证方式共同体现作者的情感、态度和价值观。
options: A. 文章的插图颜色。
B. 作者的措辞（褒义/贬义词汇）、举例与论证倾向等文本证据。
C. 读者的个人喜好。
D. 文章发表的时间。

items.stem: 态度阐释填空（用中文作答）：某评论写道 "Sadly, the old theatre, which once hosted the city's finest performances, is now a car park." 句中 Sadly 和 once ... finest 表达了作者对老剧院现状的______态度。
items.solution: Sadly（令人遗憾的是）奠定情感基调，once hosted the finest performances（今昔对比）强化惋惜之情——这是通过措辞评价作者态度的典型路径。

items.stem:
【阅读·逻辑推理】
All the flights to Chengdu were cancelled because of the storm. Ms. Wang had planned to attend a conference there at 9 a.m. on Monday. She called the organizer, apologized, and asked whether she could present her paper by video instead. The organizer agreed.
问题：What can we logically conclude?
items.solution: 由事实链推理：航班取消→她申请视频报告→组织者同意，可推出她将以视频方式参会（B）。A 与取消矛盾；C 原文未提会议取消；D 无依据。
options: A. Ms. Wang arrived in Chengdu on time.
B. Ms. Wang found another way to take part in the conference.
C. The conference was cancelled.
D. The storm lasted a whole week.

items.stem: "Every member of the chess club attended the match on Friday. Li Ming is a member of the chess club." 从这两个前提出发可以严格推出：
items.solution: 三段论推理：全体成员都到场 + 李明是成员 → 李明到场。A、C、D 都引入了前提中没有的信息。
options: A. Li Ming won the match.
B. Li Ming attended the match on Friday.
C. Li Ming is the club leader.
D. Li Ming does not like chess.

items.stem: 逻辑推理填空（用中文作答）：推理必须以语篇中的______为依据，结论不能超出证据支持的范围，否则就犯了过度推断的错误。
items.solution: 逻辑推理的纪律：结论须由文本事实（证据）严格支撑，超出证据的推断即为过度推断（over-inference）。

items.stem:
【阅读·修辞】
"Knowledge is a light that grows brighter the more we share it. In remote villages, small libraries have become windows opening onto the wider world."
问题：The metaphors in the sentence compare knowledge and libraries to ______.
items.solution: 隐喻识别：Knowledge is a light（知识是光）与 libraries ... become windows（图书馆是窗户），本体与喻体的对应关系是 light 与 windows。
options: A. a light and windows
B. money and banks
C. food and kitchens
D. water and rivers

items.stem: "Time is a thief that steals our youth." 这句话的修辞效果是：
items.solution: 隐喻（metaphor）以具体喻抽象：thief 喻 time，steals 喻时间流逝对青春的消磨，A 正确；D 搞错了本体与喻体。
options: A. 把时间比作小偷，形象地表达时间悄然流逝、带走青春。
B. 说明真的有小偷在偷东西。
C. 只是普通的陈述句，没有修辞。
D. 把青春比作小偷。

items.stem: 隐喻理解填空（用中文作答）："The city never sleeps." 用 sleeps 隐喻城市的______（填两字词），属于把城市当作人来写的______手法。
items.answer: 热闹（不眠/昼夜运转）；拟人（personification，隐喻性修辞）
items.solution: "从不睡觉"以人的行为隐喻城市昼夜运转、活力不息，属于拟人化的隐喻表达。

items.stem:
【阅读·结构分析】阅读提纲：
Para 1: Plastic waste in oceans has doubled since 2000.
Para 2-3: Causes — single-use products; weak recycling systems.
Para 4-5: Solutions — bans on some single-use plastics; new recycling technology.
Para 6: With joint efforts, the trend can still be turned around.
问题：Which pattern best describes the organization of the text?
items.solution: 第 1 段提出现象，2-3 段析因，4-5 段给对策，第 6 段收束展望，属典型的"现象—原因—结果/对策"式总分总结构。
options: A. 总—分—总（现象—原因—对策—展望）
B. 按人物生平时间顺序
C. 按空间方位（东南西北）
D. 对比两个人物

items.stem: 一篇语篇先描述"共享单车乱停乱放"的问题，接着介绍某市"电子围栏+信用分"的做法及成效。该语篇的深层结构是：
items.solution: 先呈现问题、再给出措施与效果，是 problem-solution 结构；识别深层结构有助于预测行文与定位信息。
options: A. 问题—解决（problem-solution）
B. 时间顺序
C. 分类说明
D. 人物传记

items.stem: 结构分析填空（用中文作答）："现象—原因—结果"与"问题—解决"属于语篇的______结构；而句与句之间的指代、连接属于______衔接层面。
items.answer: 深层（宏观逻辑）；局部（语法/词汇）
items.solution: 深层结构指语篇整体的宏观逻辑框架（总分总、问题—解决、现象—原因—结果），区别于句子层面的语法词汇衔接。

items.stem: 就"中学生带手机上学"发表评论，立场鲜明又客观的开口方式是：
items.solution: 评论要求立场鲜明：In my opinion 亮明观点，后接 mainly because 给出理由，既明确又有理据。
options: A. In my opinion, allowing phones at school does more harm than good, mainly because ...
B. Everyone knows phones are bad. No discussion needed.
C. I don't care about this at all.
D. Phones are phones. Schools are schools.

items.stem: 评论表达填空（用中文作答）：对事件或经历进行评论时，常用的英文句式有 As far as I'm concerned, ...；From my point of ____, ...（补全这个短语）。
items.solution: From my point of view 是表达个人立场的常用句式；同类表达还有 As far as I'm concerned / It seems to me that ...

items.stem: 一段好的评论（comment）通常包含：
items.solution: 评论的结构要素：立场（claim）+理由/例证（support），高水平评论还会让步承认对立面再回应（rebuttal），B 最完整。
options: A. 只有情绪宣泄，没有理由。
B. 明确的立场 + 至少一条支撑理由/例证，必要时承认另一方面再作回应。
C. 完全复述事件本身，不加评价。
D. 只有结论，拒绝任何解释。

items.stem: 同学问你对自己演讲表现的看法，你既想指出不足又不想打击对方，最得体的说法是：
items.solution: B 用 On the whole（总体肯定）+ maybe you could（模糊建议）缓冲批评，兼顾真诚与礼貌；A 过于伤人，C 不真诚，D 回避。
options: A. It was a total disaster.
B. On the whole it was quite good; if I had to suggest one thing, maybe you could slow down a little in the middle.
C. Perfect! No problems at all.
D. I don't want to talk about it.

items.stem: 下列哪种情形最适合使用模糊语（如 sort of、kind of、a bit）？
items.solution: 模糊语用于人际软化和留余地（评价、批评、不确定判断）；精确数据、紧急信息、规则宣读要求明确无误。
options: A. 报告实验的精确数据时。
B. 委婉评价他人的表演、缓和批评时。
C. 紧急呼救时。
D. 宣读比赛规则时。

items.stem: 口语委婉填空：A: Do you like my new haircut? B: Well, it's ... um ... certainly very ______ (short). （B 想委婉表示"太短了"，补一个得体的形容词）
items.solution: 用 it's certainly very unusual/different 这类模糊措辞，既不撒谎又不直接伤人，是口语中常见的委婉策略。

items.stem: 【应用文·想象写作】假设 2050 年你将作为一名宇航员在月球基地生活一周。请用英语写一段约 60 词的短文，向读者"再现"这段想象中的经历（描写所见、所感，力求有画面感）。
items.answer: 参考范文：When I open the window of the Moon Base, the grey dust shines like silver snow under the Earthlight. Our small green house is full of lettuce and tomatoes — the only bright colours here. Every morning I float past the sleeping pods to the lab, where my partner is already testing the water recycler. At "night", I look up at the blue Earth hanging in the black sky, and I miss the sound of rain. (画面感要点：色彩、光、动作、声音缺失的对比)
items.solution: 想象再现的写作要点：选择具体可感的细节（颜色、光、动作、声音），用比喻与对比营造画面感；时态用一般现在时使经历如在眼前。

items.stem: 要"富有画面感"地再现想象经历，下列哪种写法效果最好？
items.solution: 画面感来自具体感官细节：视觉（落日、桃汁色的天空）、味觉（风里的咸味），B 以可感细节再现场景；A/C/D 抽象笼统。
options: A. It was very nice and I was very happy.
B. The orange sun sank into the sea, and the sky turned the colour of peach juice; I could taste salt on the wind.
C. I did many things there.
D. The trip was interesting.

items.stem: 口头再现想象经历时，帮助听众"看到"场景的有效手段不包括：
items.solution: 感官词汇、比喻对比、现在时态代入都是增强画面感的手段；罗列抽象词并草草结束则相反。
options: A. 使用具体的感官词汇（colour, sound, smell）。
B. 运用比喻和对比。
C. 用现在时态把听众带入现场。
D. 只罗列抽象形容词并频繁看表结束。

items.stem: 你向外教解释"冬至"时只说 "Winter-Coming Day"，对方一脸困惑。最有效的修复策略是：
items.solution: 修复交际障碍的高级策略：复述/释义（paraphrase）+举例（dumplings、shortest day），把文化概念转成对方可理解的语言。
options: A. 直接放弃说：Forget it.
B. 换一种方式解释：It's a traditional festival on the shortest day of the year, when families in northern China eat dumplings. 即用释义+举例说明。
C. 重复原来的词并加大音量。
D. 假装对方已经听懂，继续下一话题。

items.stem: 当交流出现理解障碍时，下列属于有效修复策略的有（多选）：
items.solution: 修复策略：释义复述、举例说明、适度幽默、请求重复（Pardon?）；D 是破坏性的，不属于修复。
options: A. 用更简单的词语重新解释（复述）。
B. 举一个具体的例子说明。
C. 适当使用幽默缓解尴尬后继续沟通。
D. 责怪对方听力不好。

items.stem: 交际修复填空（用中文作答）：当你发现自己的英文表达引起误解时，可以用 "______" 请求对方澄清，或说 "What I meant was ..." 重新表述。（写出一个以 S 开头的英语短语）
items.answer: Sorry (I mean ...) / 或者 So what you are saying is ...
items.solution: 修复话语示例：Sorry, I mean ...（抱歉，我是说……）、What I meant was ...（我的意思是……）、So what you are saying is ...?（你是说……吗，用于确认理解）。

items.stem:
【阅读·历史文化】
The Grand Canal of China, dug over 1,000 years ago, once carried grain from the south to the capital in the north. In the 20th century, railways and roads replaced much of its transport role, and parts of it fell into disuse. Since 2014, however, cities along the canal have cleaned the water and repaired the banks; today tourist boats sail where cargo ships once worked, and old warehouses have become museums and bookshops.
问题：Which best summarizes the canal's change?
items.solution: 脉络梳理：运粮水道→铁路公路兴起而衰落→治理后旅游船通行、仓库变博物馆书店，即"从粮道变为文化旅游走廊"，A 正确。
options: A. From a grain route to a cultural and tourist corridor.
B. From a railway to an airport.
C. From a museum to a warehouse.
D. It has never changed at all.

items.stem:
【完形·社会变迁】
In just thirty years, the fishing village has ___ into a modern city: skyscrapers stand where fishing boats once anchored, and young programmers have replaced fishermen as the main residents.
items.solution: transform into（转变为）概括渔村变都市的巨变；后文摩天楼、程序员替代渔民的具体对照也支持"转型"语义。
options: A. transformed
B. refused
C. remembered
D. borrowed

items.stem: 【应用文·主题表达】以 "Why We Protect Old Streets"（为什么我们要保护老街区）为题，用英语写一段约 50 词的短文，在历史文化主题语境中表达观点并给出两条理由。
items.answer: 参考范文：Old streets are not broken places; they are living history. First, they keep the memory of a city — the stone bridges and shop signs tell how people lived. Second, they bring visitors and help local crafts survive. Protecting them means protecting our cultural roots while the city moves forward. (要点：观点+两条理由+收束)
items.solution: 主题表达结构：亮明观点（living history）→ 两条理由（城市记忆、旅游与手工艺）→ 呼应主题收束（cultural roots）。

items.stem:
【阅读·人与自然】
A small island once depended on fishing. As catches fell, the islanders faced a choice: build larger boats to fish farther, or protect the sea and find new ways to live. They chose the second path. They set up a no-fishing zone, started seaweed farming, and trained fishermen as guides for eco-tourists. Ten years later, fish have returned, and the island earns more from tourism than it ever did from fishing.
问题：Which is the best title for the passage?
items.solution: 主旨题：岛民以"保护海洋+转型生计"实现可持续发展，B 概括了"护海即护岛"的核心；A 与原文选择相反；C、D 偏离主线。
options: A. More Boats, More Fish
B. Saving the Sea, Saving the Island
C. The End of Fishing Villages
D. Why Tourists Love Islands

items.stem: 【应用文·可持续论证】你校英文报就 "Should disposable plastic boxes be banned in the school canteen?" 征文。请用英语写一段约 60 词的短文，表明立场并用两条理由支持（人与自然可持续主题）。
items.answer: 参考范文：In my view, disposable plastic boxes should be banned in our canteen. For one thing, most of them are used for only twenty minutes but remain in the environment for hundreds of years, harming soil and animals. For another, reusable boxes are easy: students can bring their own or borrow returnable ones, as many universities have done. A small change in habit can protect our planet for good. (立场+两条理由+呼吁)
items.solution: 论证结构：明确立场（In my view ... should be banned）→ 理由一（长期污染）→ 理由二（可行替代）→ 呼吁收束。

items.stem:
【完形·自然主题】
Wetlands are often called the "kidneys of the earth" because they ___ water naturally, removing pollutants and storing floodwater. Destroying them for short-term farmland finally costs far more than it earns.
items.solution: "肾脏"的比喻指向过滤（filter）功能：去除污染物、蓄洪，B 与比喻及后文细节一致。
options: A. pollute
B. filter
C. sell
D. boil

items.stem:
【多模态语篇】一张环保海报：左侧是被塑料袋缠绕的海龟特写（冷色调），右侧是布袋与帆布包（暖色调），中间大字标语 "Your bag, their life."，底部小字网站与日期。
问题：海报中文字与图像如何共同建构意义？
items.solution: 多模态意义建构：冷/暖色调对比塑造情感倾向，图像（受害海龟）提供情感证据，标语（Your bag, their life）完成因果关联与行动号召，模态互补共同说服。
options: A. 图像唤起对海洋生物受害的情感共鸣，标语把"你的选择"与"它们的生命"直接关联，共同劝说观众少用塑料袋。
B. 图像和文字互不相干。
C. 文字只用于装饰，没有意义。
D. 海报只是艺术作品，与环保无关。

items.stem: 分析一则短视频广告时，"多模态"视角意味着要同时关注：
items.solution: 多模态分析：文字、声音、画面（构图、色彩、镜头）等资源相互配合建构意义，不能只看单一模态。
options: A. 只看画面内容。
B. 文字、声音（配乐/旁白）、画面（构图/色彩）及其如何协同表达意义。
C. 只统计视频时长。
D. 只读字幕。

items.stem: 关于媒介语篇的多模态建构，下列分析恰当的有（多选）：
items.solution: A（音乐+镜头共同渲染氛围）、B（视觉线索引导注意力）、D（图表色彩编码数据）都是多模态协同建构意义的实例；C 否认模态互动，错误。
options: A. 纪录片中低沉的配乐与缓慢的镜头共同渲染忧伤氛围。
B. 杂志封面上人物的眼神方向引导读者注意标题。
C. 广告里声音和画面完全各自独立、互不影响意义。
D. 报纸图表用颜色深浅表示数据大小，帮助读者快速理解。

items.stem: Choose the word closest in meaning to the underlined word: The manager's plan was very practical and solved the problem without wasting money.
items.solution: practical（务实的、实用的）与 realistic（现实可行的）近义；theoretical（理论的）、ridiculous（荒谬的）、vague（模糊的）均相反或无关。
options: A. theoretical
B. realistic
C. ridiculous
D. vague

items.stem:
【完形·词汇运用】
To ___ the problem of food waste, the restaurant now offers half-size dishes and gives leftover food to a charity that feeds homeless people every evening.
items.solution: address a problem（解决问题）是高频搭配；admire（钦佩）、admit（承认）、adjust（调整）都不与 problem 构成"解决"义。
options: A. address
B. admire
C. admit
D. adjust

items.stem: 词汇运用填空：The scientist's report was so ______ (persuade) that even critics changed their positions. （用 persuade 的适当形式填空）
items.solution: 表示"有说服力的"用形容词 persuasive；so ... that 结构中需要形容词作表语。

items.stem: 借助定义理解学术概念词："Sustainability means using resources in a way that meets today's needs without destroying the ability of future generations to meet theirs." 根据定义，sustainability 的核心含义是：
items.solution: 定义句给出充分必要条件：满足今日需求 + 不损害后代满足其需求的能力，即"可持续利用"，A 正确。抽象概念词应借助定义与语境掌握。
options: A. 资源的可持续利用（兼顾当代与后代需求）
B. 无限开采资源
C. 只考虑当代人的利益
D. 完全停止使用任何资源

items.stem: 术语填空（用英文作答）：In a research report, the part that defines the range and limits of the study is called the ______ (以 sc- 开头，意为"研究范围").
items.solution: scope（研究范围）是学术写作高频术语，常与 define/limit 搭配：define the scope of the study。

items.stem: 下列句子中 hypothesis 一词用法正确的是：
items.solution: hypothesis（假设）是研究的待验证命题，用法为 put forward / test a hypothesis；A 正确展示了"提出假设—实验验证"的学术用法。
options: A. Our hypothesis is that plants grow faster with music, and the experiment will test it.
B. The hypothesis ate the plants.
C. We hypothesis the music loudly.
D. Hypothesis is a kind of flower.

items.stem: 把"人多力量大"直译成 "Many people, big power"，英语读者困惑。更地道的意译是：
items.solution: 英汉对比：汉语重意合的四字格宜在英语中寻找对应谚语（意译），Many hands make light work 正表达"人多好办事"。
options: A. Many hands make light work.
B. Many people, big power.
C. People are power.
D. More people, more power.

items.stem: 关于英汉词汇差异，下列说法正确的有（多选）：
items.solution: A、B、D 都是英汉不对等与"直译陷阱"的实例；C 错：两种语言词汇并非一一对应，正因如此要区分直译与意译。
options: A. 汉语"大"在不同搭配中对应英语不同词（大雨 heavy rain、大风 strong wind、大国 big/powerful country）。
B. 英语词义常依赖语境与搭配，逐字直译常造成误解。
C. 英汉两种语言的所有词语都能一一对应。
D. "红茶"的英语是 black tea 而非 red tea，体现颜色词不对等。

items.stem: 翻译策略填空（用中文作答）："他英语很好" 译成 His English is very good 固然可以，但更地道的表达是 He speaks good English / His English is excellent。这说明汉英转换时应优先考虑英语的______与习惯表达，而非字字对应（填"搭配"或"词性"，选一个）。
items.solution: 同一汉语意思在英语中有不同的惯用搭配（speak good English），按搭配与习惯表达选词比逐字直译更地道。

items.stem:
【完形·词块运用】
When the fire alarm went off, all the students ___ the building quickly and gathered on the playground, where teachers counted them one by one.
items.solution: 词块 evacuate the building（撤离大楼）与 fire alarm、gathered on the playground 同现，构成"火警—撤离—集合点名"的词块链。
options: A. evacuated
B. decorated
C. visited
D. painted

items.stem: 词块填空：请在横线处填入合适的介词，使搭配完整：The accident resulted ______ three injuries, and the police are looking ______ the cause.
items.solution: 词块积累：result in（导致）与 look into（调查）都是高频动词+介词搭配，整体记忆并在语篇中调用。

items.stem: "深度学习"一个单词（如 charge）最有效的做法是：
items.solution: 深度学习词语＝多义项归纳＋词块积累＋语境运用，提高使用的准确性与丰富性；单背一个义项是浅层学习。
options: A. 只背 charge = 充电 一个义项。
B. 在不同语境中归纳其多义（charge a phone 充电 / in charge of 负责 / a charge of 2 yuan 收费），并积累相关词块。
C. 把字母拆开一个一个背。
D. 只在单词表里见过一次就算掌握。

items.stem:
— I heard Tom passed the driving test on his first try.
— Really? That's a piece of cake for him — he practised every day for two years.
问题：What does "a piece of cake" mean?
items.solution: 习语 a piece of cake 意为"小菜一碟、轻而易举的事"；语境（每天练两年）也支持"对他来说很容易"。
options: A. Something very easy.
B. A kind of dessert.
C. Something very expensive.
D. A birthday party.

items.stem: 选词填空：After hours of arguing, the two sides finally saw eye to eye on the plan. Here "see eye to eye" means ______.
items.solution: see eye to eye（意见一致）是高频习语；上文"争论数小时后终于……"提示达成一致。
options: A. to look at each other
B. to agree with each other
C. to fight with each other
D. to see a doctor

items.stem: 习语运用填空：想表达"机不可失，时不再来"，可用英语习语 "Time and ______ wait for no man."（补全这个习语）
items.solution: Time and tide wait for no man（岁月不待人）是英语常用谚语，与"机不可失"义近。

items.stem: 围绕"环境保护（environmental protection）"这一语义场，下列词语属于该词汇网络的有（多选）：
items.solution: recycling（回收）、carbon emission（碳排放）、renewable energy（可再生能源）同属环保语义场；recipe（食谱/配方）属于烹饪语义场。
options: A. recycling
B. carbon emission
C. recipe
D. renewable energy

items.stem:
【完形·语义场调用】
The doctor examined the patient, wrote down the ___, and told the nurse how often the medicine should be taken. Words like examine, patient, medicine and nurse all belong to the field of hospitals.
items.solution: 医院语义场（examine/patient/nurse/medicine）中与"服药频次"相关的记录是 prescription（处方）；harvest（收获）、timetable（时刻表）、passport（护照）分属其他语义场。
options: A. prescription
B. harvest
C. timetable
D. passport

items.stem: 语义场归类填空（用中文作答）：把 transport 语义场中的词分为三类：bus, tram, ferry 属于______工具；station, platform, terminal 属于______设施；driver, conductor, passenger 属于相关______。
items.answer: 交通（运输）；场站（交通）；人员（角色）
items.solution: 语义场内部可再按"工具—设施—人员"等维度分层组块，成组记忆、成组调用。

items.stem: 科技伦理主题词群辨析：With AI deciding who gets a loan, banks must consider questions of ______ — is the decision fair to every applicant?
items.solution: AI 贷款决策涉及算法公平与偏见（fairness/bias）问题，属科技伦理词群；后文 is the decision fair 给出定义线索。
options: A. dessert
B. fairness (bias)
C. weather
D. fashion

items.stem: 主题词群填空：Environmental reports often discuss the ______ (碳) footprint of products and encourage companies to cut pollution. （用英文填空）
items.solution: carbon footprint（碳足迹）是环境主题高频词块；同类词群还有 carbon emission、low-carbon lifestyle 等。

items.stem: 下列词组中属于"艺术（art）"主题词群的有（多选）：
items.solution: oil painting（油画）、sculpture（雕塑）、calligraphy（书法）属艺术词群；database（数据库）属信息技术词群。
options: A. oil painting
B. sculpture
C. database
D. calligraphy

items.stem: 给好友发消息说"周六来我家吃饭吧"，最合适的表达是：
items.solution: 选词看对象与场合：好友+非正式场合用随意的祈使句 Come over for dinner!；A 是正式请柬用语，用于好友显得疏远滑稽；C、D 是命令口吻，失礼。
options: A. We request the pleasure of your company at dinner on Saturday.
B. Come over for dinner on Saturday!
C. You are ordered to attend dinner on Saturday.
D. Dinner will be served on Saturday, attendance required.

items.stem:
【完形·语域选词】
At the international conference, the young researcher ___ her ideas carefully with formal terms and complete sentences, quite differently from the casual way she talked with classmates.
items.solution: 国际会议的正式场合与 formal terms 提示用 present（正式陈述）；chatted（闲聊）、whispered（耳语）、joked（开玩笑）都是非正式语域动词。
options: A. presented
B. chatted
